**Owl Ears v2** - a small Windows song recogniser. One exe, nothing to install (Windows 10 / 11, 64-bit).

- **PC SOUND** - what this PC plays · **MICROPHONE** - what the room plays · **FILE...** - a music file
- The song, its cover, album / year / genre, where in the song the heard piece was, speed and pitch differences
- KEEP LISTENING, a history log, OPEN IN SHAZAM, COPY

Download `OwlEars.exe` (or the zip, with the README and licences) and run it. Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher (the exe is not signed): *More info → Run anyway*.

v2: renamed to Owl Ears (v1 was "ThunderEar"); the history log moves along by itself.

> Unofficial: not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by Shazam or Apple; it may stop working at any time. Only the song's signature (about 1 kB of spectral peaks) leaves the PC - never the sound.
